notes.title: Update on April 7th (Fri)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/c25bdaacd80ff3ebf6c33f87f9392a8a8cb0cfc0.png[/img]

Hello. This is Soul Guardians.

A temporary inspection will be conducted on April 7th (Fri).
Please refer to the schedule below to avoid any inconvenience while using the game.

[Maintenance Time]
- April 7, 2023 (Friday) 10:20~10:40 (UTC)

[Precautions]
- The game service will not be available during the inspection and the inspection schedule may change.


[Update Details]

<Maintenance Content>
- The issue of items disappearing intermittently during trades will be fixed.
- The number of Battle Stones obtained in Free Fighting mode will be increased threefold compared to the previous amount.
- The error of using skills in the direction where no monsters are present in Auto Dungeon will be fixed.
- The drop amounts of Balder's Fragment and Thor's Fragment will be adjusted according to the act-specific drop rate.
- The PVP restriction on the skill level addition option for Dress Accessory Orbs will be lifted.

<New System>
- Chain Arts Set Effects will be added.
Chain Arts Set Effects will activate when collecting two or more cards in a specific combination.
Frontal attacks will be applied to 2, 4, and 6 sets, while aerial attacks will be applied to 2 and 4 sets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/9e3a9933884d1a62129fb8722748ff2289233c03.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/f29e969dce9d0c26f29420165c8e83a1e913eb03.png[/img]

※The set effect values will be applied based on the basic base of the card, not the evolved card.

<New Content>
- Floors 2 and 3 of the Apostle's Labyrinth will be opened, and you can obtain cape equipment from the Apostle's Labyrinth.
- Auto Dungeons will be reorganized into maps suitable for their respective regions.

<Event Announcement>
- The B2Coin event will end on Monday, April 10th.

<Product Announcement>
- The Petite Cupid Dress Package will be on sale starting April 7th.
- Kawing's Box Season 2 will be on sale starting April 7th.
- Season Pass Season 1 is scheduled to end on April 10th.

<Precautions>
1) All Rubies obtained from Kawing's Box Season 1 will be changed to Faded Rubies.
   Faded Rubies cannot be used in the Ruby Shop and can be sold in the store for Gran.


Thank you.

notes.title: Update on March 10th (Fri)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/c25bdaacd80ff3ebf6c33f87f9392a8a8cb0cfc0.png[/img]

Hello, this is Soul Guardians.

We would like to inform you of the updated content after the maintenance on March 24th, 2023 (Fri). Please refer to the following contents to ensure that there are no inconveniences in using the game.


[Update Details]

<Changes>
- The stats and score calculation method for bots that can be encountered in the Challengea 1vs1 battle have been partially changed.
- A message will be displayed when the inventory is full and cannot receive today's item.
- The labeling method for Chain Arts stars will be changed.
- Exchange items for 1000 units of Gamble Chips have been added.
- The limit for adding skill levels in PVP has been changed to not exceed the limit for original skill levels.
- The issue where the entrance to the dungeon is not visible when progressing through the level 93 sub-quest "Prevent Information Leakage" has been fixed.
- Some quest rewards given by daily quests and mission guides have been changed.
- When entering an Elite Dungeon and failing to clear it, the player will be stuck for 3 minutes.
- The Mirion Elite Map will be replaced.
- The achievement reward for the 70th round of the Territory War will be changed.
- Accessory exchange at the Beginner's Exchange will be limited to one time.

<Product Notice>
- On March 24th, Rushing, Unlimited Health/Magic Herbs, Green Star Speech Bubble, Green Star Name Tag, Imperial Speech Bubble, and Imperial Name Tag will be discontinued at the Mileage Shop.

<New Content>
1. The Territory Wars of Esther and Breiten will be newly opened.
1) Territory War Application Method
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/f1c900c1b361dc72314ec1db1bd2fad4059b7e93.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/a642377e0b4eda60412852999b0015126210e666.png[/img]
- Application Period: 24 hours to 1 hour before the event time (refer to each territory management NPC-Territory War Application)
- Application Cost: 100,000G
- Qualification: Guild Master
- Event Time
Elain Territory: Every Saturday 12:00 (UTC)
Esther Territory: Every Sunday 12:00 (UTC)
Breiten Territory: Every Friday 19:00 (UTC)
- Application Method: Deposit the application fee in the guild storage after applying at each village storage NPC, then apply for the Territory War to the Territory Management NPC.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/801ced284a39e18aa0d39125a70eb75276a998db.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/e51176f5587c2d44b300bf21c67a96b99328f0e9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/f1c900c1b361dc72314ec1db1bd2fad4059b7e93.png[/img]
2) Territory War Progress Method
A. When the "Matching Preparation" button in the top left corner is clicked, automatic matching will begin.
B. The Territory War will take a total of one hour.
- Each battle lasts for a maximum of 5 minutes.
- 5 points are awarded per party member for winning, and 1 point is awarded for losing.
C. The winning side can continue to match for battles.
- The losing side will be imprisoned on the Forgotten Island for a certain period of time.
- After being imprisoned, they must return to the territory where the Territory War is in progress to rematch.
D. While waiting inside the territory during the Territory War, 1 PT is earned for every minute of waiting time.
E. If more than two territories are occupied simultaneously, a penalty will be given at the start of the Territory War.
F. Territory-specific events
Elain Territory: Unadjusted Occupation Battle (requires a party of 2 or more)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/c62faf7c9a30b48820e04c326baf5f0ba63cc724.png[/img]
Esther Territory: 1vs1 Duel
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/ab1aac624cf9e72279c484192e2eea54e3d0fe57.png[/img]
Breiten Territory: Mobidic
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/1998740c46823a373ea39d5d5c686022227ba0c8.png[/img]
- Unlike the existing Mobidic, lightning strikes on random footholds and the player is eliminated.
3) Victory Conditions
A. The guild that obtains the highest score through battles during the Territory War will occupy the territory.
B. In case of a tie, the guild that applied for the Territory War first will have priority.
4) Benefits
A. Exclusive use of the territory for one week
B. Obtain 1.5 times the application fee for the Territory War
C. Unique content such as Original Dungeons, Shops, Exchange Shops, and Gathering are provided in the territory.
- Elaine - Royal Tomb
- Esther - Petra Sanctuary
- Breiton - Lost Castle
- Harvest - Thorny Forest
- Hammeren - Cahill Bridge

2. A Golden Merchant will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/a185d4953b261cfc2c6fd9c48c0ade4ede493c4d.png[/img]
The Golden Merchant will sell rare treasures collected during their travels throughout Mirgard in limited quantities. What treasure will they bring this time?
※ The Golden Merchant's shop will sell a limited quantity of items each time they appear.

3. The Glory Commendation Shop will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/54a0b84bf50cce2172deb6c5e22889a0a608848e.png[/img]
A shop where you can exchange daily quest rewards for Glory Commendations will be added.
Thank you.

notes.title: Update on March 10th (Fri)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/c25bdaacd80ff3ebf6c33f87f9392a8a8cb0cfc0.png[/img]

Hello. Soul Guardians.

A temporary inspection will be conducted on March 10th (Fri). Please refer to the schedule below to avoid any inconvenience while using the game.

[Maintenance Time]
- March March March 10th (Fri), 11:00~11:20 (UTC)

[Precautions]
- The game service will not be available during the inspection and the inspection schedule may change.


[Update Details]

<Maintenance Content>
- The Baldur's resurrection stone will be changed to only be usable on rare or lower rarity equipment.
- The Hell mode entrance ticket, "Hell Key," item will be added.
- A new item, Thor's resurrection stone, will be added.
- Thor's resurrection stone can recover equipment up to epic rarity or lower.
※ The existing Baldur resurrection stone can no longer be used on epic equipment.

<New content>
1. The Maze of Apostles will be added.
The Maze of Apostles can be entered once a day and allows players to obtain accessories.

2. Hell mode dungeons will be opened.
Hell mode dungeons have various terrain effects that apply penalties to players depending on the terrain effect.
※ Hell Key entrance tickets can be purchased in the store or obtained as drops from the final boss of Khalil-Atlantis hard dungeons and the Hell mode ACT last boss.
Hell Key items can be purchased for 5000G and NPCs that sell them include:
Barris - Tool Shop NPC
Petra's Shrine - Dungeon Guide NPC
Lost Castle - Tool Shop NPC
Thorny Forest - Dungeon Guide NPC
Khalil Bridge - Pharmacy Store NPC
Mirion Ruins - Dungeon Guide NPC
Atlantis - Dungeon Guide NPC

※ Terrain Effects:
Fire attribute dungeon: After a certain period of time, players receive continuous burn damage.
Ice attribute dungeon: The player's movement speed slows down over time.
Wind attribute dungeon: Monster's movement and attack speed increase.
Earth attribute dungeon: After a certain period of time, an earthquake occurs, causing players to fall over.


3. Territory battles will be added.
 1) Preparing for Territory Battles:
  - Application period: 24 hours before the event
  - Application fee: 100,000G
  - Qualifications for application: Guild Master
  - Event Time
     Elaine Territory: Every Saturday at 12:00 (UTC)
     ※Currently, only the Elaine Territory Battle is open, and other territories will be added gradually.
  - Application Method
    ① Deposit the application fee in the guild storage box through the village storage NPC.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/801ced284a39e18aa0d39125a70eb75276a998db.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/e51176f5587c2d44b300bf21c67a96b99328f0e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/be6f24e7f56a6b62bfa7333c73d53777a0b6bc51.png[/img]
    ② Apply for the territory battle to the Territory Management NPC.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/f1c900c1b361dc72314ec1db1bd2fad4059b7e93.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/a642377e0b4eda60412852999b0015126210e666.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/b234fd97714e2b83cd9f7ddb06678443b589b20f.png[/img]

 2) Territory Battle Progress:
    a. Only a 2-person party composed of the same guild members can participate in the territory battle.
    b. When the party leader clicks the [Matching Preparation] button in the upper left corner, 
        automatic matching takes place.
    c. The territory battle takes a total of 1 hour to complete.
       Each battle lasts for a maximum of 5 minutes.
       If a party wins a battle, each party member receives 5 points, 
       and if the party loses, each member receives 1 point.
    d. A party that wins a battle can continue to match for battles.
        A party that loses will be imprisoned on a deserted island for a certain period of time.
        After being imprisoned, the party must return to the territory 
        where the battle is taking place to rematch.
    e. During the waiting period in the territory battle, each party earns 1 point per minute of waiting time.
    f. If two or more territories are occupied simultaneously, a point penalty will be imposed at the start of the territory battle.
   g. Territory-specific events:
i. Elaine Territory: Unadjusted Occupation Battle (Spec War)
(1) The team that destroys the opponent's core boss first wins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/687e7a988016ff8de2300548747a5c8ce10f09f5.png[/img]
(2) All bosses must be defeated before the core boss can be destroyed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/4a395d0c0bec1d1d448ee195b859dff0813c600f.png[/img]
(3) Allies are identified by blue flags and enemies by red flags.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/3aecde1350fe03cb2864d361a48a5d0938d27ff6.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43588216/14499bde52b61dbdc8b9257c8b8b1f4fd2443468.png[/img]
3) Benefits
a. Exclusive use of the territory for one week
b. Obtaining 1 million G
c. Provide unique content for the territory such as original dungeons, shops, exchange centers, and gathering spots
d. Obtain a portion of the recovery center usage fee from designated dungeons as taxes.
Elaine - Tomb of the Royal Family
Esther - Petra's Sanctuary
Brayton - Lost Castle
Harvest - Thorny Forest
Hamern - Cahill Bridge


Thank you.
